description: This file defines the Tiptap class for handling rich text content, including conversion to HTML, Markdown, and plain text, as well as media insertion, attachment resolution, and content extraction within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Tiptap
classes.description: A class for manipulating and converting rich text content, supporting HTML, Markdown, and plain text formats, as well as media and attachment handling.

methods.name: toHTML
methods.description: Returns the stored content as HTML string.

methods.name: toTXT
methods.description: Converts the content to plain text.

methods.name: toMD
methods.description: Converts the content to Markdown format.

methods.name: toHeadline
methods.description: Extracts the headline from the content.

methods.name: toTitle
methods.description: Extracts a title from the content with a maximum length.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for a query within the content.

methods.name: insertBlockIds
methods.description: Inserts block IDs into HTML elements.

methods.name: async insertMedia
methods.description: Replaces image hashes with actual media URLs using a resolver function.

methods.name: async resolveAttachments
methods.description: Resolves and replaces attachment elements with actual content.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts blocks and internal links from the content.

methods.name: removeAttachments
methods.description: Removes specified attachments from the content.

methods.name: async postProcess
methods.description: Processes content to save attachments and resolve internal links.
